Pitch An App - Pitch your app idea. People vote. We build the winners. You earn.

# Your idea. Their votes. A real app.

Pitch your app idea. People vote. We build the winners. You earn.

24 Apps Built

50% Off for Voters

$0 To Pitch or Vote

What app do you wish existed?

Open Ideas In Progress (1) Built Apps

1

### Pitch Your Idea

Describe the app you want built. What problem does it solve? Who needs it?

### Gather Votes

Share your pitch. When enough people vote for it, it moves to production.

3

### Earn Revenue

Your app gets built and launched. You earn revenue share. Voters get 50% off forever.

### How many votes does my idea need?

The default threshold is 50 votes, but some ideas may have different thresholds. Once your idea reaches it, we review it for building.

### What kind of revenue share do submitters get?

Submitters earn 5-10% of the revenue their app generates. The exact share depends on the app complexity and market potential.

### What do voters get?

Voters who back a winning idea get 50% off the app forever. You are literally investing your vote in software you want to use.

### Who builds the apps?

Emad Ibrahim, a professional solo developer, builds every app that hits the vote threshold. These are production-quality applications, not prototypes.

### Will every idea that hits the threshold get built?

Not necessarily. The developer has final say on feasibility. Some ideas may be too broad, already exist, or have technical challenges that make them impractical.

### Is it free to submit an idea?

Yes. Submitting and voting are completely free. You only pay if you want to use an app that gets built.

## Got an app idea collecting dust?

Stop waiting. Pitch it. Let the crowd decide. Let us build it.
